basic_details.job_title: ICF Hospital Honorary Visiting Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: ICF Hospital, Chennai, through the Office of the Principal Chief Medical Officer (PCMO), has invited applications from doctors for engagement as Honorary Visiting Specialist (General Surgeon). The filled-in application with the required documents must reach The PCMO, ICF Hospital, ICF, Chennai – 600 038 on or before 15 December 2026, which is the last date of receipt. Applications are open as of 22 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About ICF Hospital
content_sections.text: ICF Hospital is a Railway hospital in Chennai (PIN 600 038). The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal Chief Medical Officer, ICF Hospital. The post falls under the Railway Board's scheme for engagement of Honorary Visiting Specialists (HVS) in Railway Hospitals, and the Railway Board letter No. 2014/H-1/12/8/HVS/Policy/E dated 22.10.2025 on revised honorarium rates is attached to the notice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use the application form titled "Application for Honorary Visiting Specialist" (Application for the Post of HVS (General Surgeon)), printed on pages 2 to 4 of the notice. Send it to this address: The PCMO, ICF Hospital, ICF, Chennai – 600 038 Fill in the form: name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth and age, nationality, community, e-mail, phone, postal address with PIN code, and qualifications from MBBS level onwards with year of passing, college/university and percentage of marks. Give your experience after the PG Degree/Diploma (period, hospital/organisation, certificate attached), including published research papers, if any. Enter your Medical Council of India/State registration number, date of issue and validity, your speciality and your place of present work (Government or Private). Affix a recent passport size photo duly attested by a Gazetted officer on the form. Attach attested Xerox copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. Sign the declaration with place and date. Make sure the application reaches the PCMO on or before 15 December 2026. The notice does not specify a postal mode (speed post, registered post or by hand) or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Post-Graduate degree from a recognized University. Minimum 3 years experience in the professional work related to the concerned Specialty after obtaining the P.G. degree. The application form also asks for the MBBS degree, an internship completion certificate and a valid registration certificate of the Medical Council of India/State. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post. During first time engagement, the preferred age is between 30 years to 64 years. The upper age limit of continued engagement is 65 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. The candidate may select any one of these Hours of Duty of their choice. The attached Railway Board letter gives these amounts as revised honorarium for a Specialist per month. There will be a deduction in remuneration for any absence beyond 12 days per annum, as per the extant Railway Board order. The Railway Board letter sets the Specialist deduction at ₹4,167/- per day for the 4 hours a day, 6 days a week option and ₹3,812/- per day for the 4 hours a day, 4 days a week option. The letter adds that the honorarium rates will be revised after 05 years of its issue.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the ICF Hospital Honorary Visiting Specialist application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Office of the PCMO, ICF Hospital, Chennai on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for ICF Hospital HVS (General Surgeon)?
faq.answer: A Post-Graduate degree from a recognized University and minimum 3 years experience in the concerned Specialty after the P.G. degree are required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ICF Hospital HVS post?
faq.answer: At first time engagement, the preferred age is between 30 years to 64 years, and the upper age limit of continued engagement is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for the ICF Hospital Honorary Visiting Specialist?
faq.answer: The honorarium is ₹1,00,000/- for 4 hours a day for 6 days a week, or ₹61,000/- for 4 hours a day for 4 days a week.

faq.question: Q5. Can I choose my working hours as an ICF Hospital HVS?
faq.answer: Yes, the candidate may select any one of the two Hours of Duty options: 4 hours a day for 6 days a week or 4 hours a day for 4 days a week.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICF Hospital HVS (General Surgeon)?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form given with the notice, attach attested copies of the listed documents, and send it to The PCMO, ICF Hospital, ICF, Chennai – 600 038 so that it reaches by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a deduction for leave in the ICF Hospital HVS engagement?
faq.answer: Yes, remuneration is deducted for any absence beyond 12 days per annum as per the extant Railway Board order, at ₹4,167/- per day (6 days a week option) or ₹3,812/- per day (4 days a week option) for a Specialist.

faq.question: Q8. Do Government doctors need an NOC to apply for ICF Hospital HVS?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate already employed in a Central/State Government hospital or organisation must attach an NOC from that Government organisation.
